reject_reason: Near-dupe of catalog loaded-beef-taco-skillet-bowls: shares protein (ground beef), Tex-Mex taco flavor family, and skillet method; cauliflower-rice swap is the only structural change. Catalog Tex-Mex beef lane is already dense (loaded-beef-taco-skillet-bowls, tex-mex-beef-rice-skillet-bowls, beef-enchilada-skillet-bowls) so it deepens not widens; plus 34g carbs sits ~1g under the ceiling and a label-accurate recompute (15oz black beans) risks breaching 35g. Cut - run does not need padding.
